game_concept: A programming puzzle set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the market bell reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Postern Gate, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the market bell reads the right value at run time. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the y value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the market bell using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the market bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Postern Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 11.
